title: A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.21439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In particle physics, discrepancies between experimental measurements and Standard Model (SM) predictions are commonly interpreted within new theoretical models. In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models. However, exploring the enormous space of possible SMEFT operators rapidly becomes a challenging combinatorial problem: many operators can contribute simultaneously to different observables, their effects are correlated, and distinct operator combinations can provide comparably good descriptions of the data. In this work, we formulate the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem using reinforcement learning (RL). translated_title: 一种用于探索SMEFT算符空间的强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 在粒子物理学中，实验测量结果与标准模型（SM）预测之间的偏差通常被纳入新理论模型的框架内加以解释。在此背景下，标准模型有效场论（SMEFT）提供了一个涵盖广泛模型类别的通用框架。然而，探索庞大的可能SMEFT算符空间很快就会变成一个具有挑战性的组合问题：许多算符可以同时对不同的可观测量产生贡献，它们的影响彼此关联，而且不同的算符组合可以对数据给出质量相近的描述。在本工作中，我们利用强化学习（RL）将SMEFT算符空间的探索表述为一个序贯决策问题。我们的强化学习智能体采用轻量级的actor-critic（演员-评论家）架构，可训练参数总共约为4万个。我们的方法并非寻找单一的最佳拟合理论，而是旨在发现……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将SMEFT算符空间的探索表述为序贯决策问题，并利用仅约4万参数的轻量级actor-critic强化学习智能体，高效地在庞大的算符组合空间中寻找能解释实验数据与标准模型偏差的多种可行算符组合。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem, using a lightweight actor-critic reinforcement learning agent with only ~40K trainable parameters to efficiently discover multiple operator combinations that can explain deviations between data and the Standard Model.
